_source: Hand-entered from the FarmShare receipts outside git, 2026-10-20. Scores are not here: they are ArchiveProcessor/segbench-results/bench-corpus/open-sweep-20261019.{csv,json}, written by corpus/farmshare_expanded_report.py. Per model: L = ~/Claude/Long term storage/FarmShare-open-sweep-20261019; model, revision, route and prompt from L/outputs/<key>/prepared.json and status.json; dtype from the vLLM log L/outputs/<key>/logs/vllm-<job>.log; collector seconds are the pilot plus full-run wall_s lines in L/remote-logs/<job>-<key>.out; server minutes are the first to the last timestamp in the vLLM log (model load included). Qwen 27B/35B rows: ~/Claude/Long term storage/FarmShare-20261019/receipts/<model>.json; their 895 readings ran in two jobs (440 on 2026-10-18, 455 in the 2026-10-19 extension), so no single wall time is given. Ling 3 Flash VL: ~/Claude/Long term storage/FarmShare-general-sweep-20261019/outputs/ling3-flash-vl-fp8 (status.json, prepared.json); it ran in two jobs on the same cache contract, 1857667 (4 h limit, 466 pages cached) and the rerun 1860274 (the other 430), and server_min adds the two vLLM log spans (240.1 + 224.7). No collector wall_s line was retrieved. PP-OCRv6: ~/Claude/Long term storage/FarmShare-ppocrv6-20261019/outputs/ppocrv6-medium-native (contract.json, summary.json, raw/); collector_s is the sum of the per-page wall_s fields, server_min the job's 5 min 26 s elapsed from execution-plans/ppocrv6-farmshare-20261019.md.
status: Review baseline for the processing review (execution-plans/processing-review/00-plan.md, Phase 0). Nothing adopted; no catalogue or default changed.
hardware: One NVIDIA L40S (48 GB) per model unless gpus says otherwise. VLM routes: vLLM 0.31.0, context 16384, temperature 0, thinking off, 8192 output tokens; 16 sequences and 8 concurrent requests, except Ling 3 Flash VL on 4 L40S (tensor parallel 4 with expert parallel, eager, 4 sequences and 4 requests). PP-OCRv6 is not vLLM and not a VLM: the stock PaddleOCR 3.7.0 detector and recognizer pipeline, no prompt and no token cap. All routes read the same 2400 px JPEG 90 inputs as the Qwen runs (image SHA-256 checked page by page).

ppocrv6-medium.note: Line detector plus recogniser, not a prompt-equivalent VLM row; separate from PaddleOCR-VL 1.5.
